text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Asahi Hai F.S., and the normally calm Biwa Hayahide seems nervous about participating in a big G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to do her best and incorporate what she learns from this race in her calculations.
